about_the_game:
Primal Glade is a heart-pounding, single-player FPS that transports you to the dangerous depths of a prehistoric jungle. Your objective is simple yet deadly: collect all the nests scattered across the rain-drenched mire and survive long enough to reach extraction. But beware—this ancient wilderness is teeming with lethal creatures that won’t let you claim victory without a fight.

Dinosaurs and other prehistoric predators roam the jungle, including Dimetrodons, agile Raptors, and cunning Troodons. Each encounter is a test of your reflexes and resourcefulness, with every creature posing a unique threat. Whether you're dodging ambushes or fending off relentless attacks, survival depends on your ability to adapt, strategize, and make every shot count.

The environment itself is as hostile as the predators that inhabit it. Soaked in relentless rain and shrouded in mist, the jungle is a maze of dense vegetation, muddy trails, and treacherous terrain. You'll need to stay alert as you navigate through the mire, knowing danger could strike at any moment.

With a playtime of 15–45 minutes, Primal Glade delivers a fast-paced, challenging experience that combines the thrill of exploration with the intensity of combat. Each moment demands focus, as every wrong step could mean the difference between life and death.

Can you outsmart prehistoric predators, collect the nests, and make it out alive? Dive into the savage world of Primal Glade and find out if you have what it takes to survive this brutal, action-packed adventure.
